Name: Ichabod, Son of Phinehas
Summary: Ichabod was born as his mother lay dying on the day the ark was captured and his father and grandfather died. She named him Ichabod, meaning 'the glory is departed from Israel.'
KeyStory: Ichabod's very name marked the day Israel lost the ark, his father, and his grandfather at once.
LifeLesson: A name can carry a nation's grief — and point to how much God's presence is worth.
